title: 卡西奥佩娅·金冠石庭
description: 卡西奥佩娅在宏大石庭盘成稳固蛇身姿态，上身高领长袖衣完整覆盖，金冠与绿金鳞片受强光切面。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Cassiopeia is an adult woman with a long continuous serpentine lower body, green-gold scales, an ornate cobra-inspired golden crown, and long dark hair. Preserve her expressive humanlike face and unmistakable snake anatomy without human legs. An opaque high-neck long-sleeved emerald tunic fully covers the upper body, while her coiled tail rests naturally and her closed mouth shows no threatening fangs.
art_direction.scene: Place her upright within a wide sunlit stone courtyard, the tail arranged in two clear grounded curves and her hands resting loosely at waist level. Her gaze turns toward a distant archway. Strong gold light cuts across the crown and scaled body in hard wax-crayon facets, while cool shadow planes and sparse columns create a stately original composition.
art_direction.palette: emerald, antique gold, dark teal, pale sandstone
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
